title: Modulation, overmodulation and link budgets
blurb: Tell AM, FM, PM, SSB and digital modulation apart, see what overmodulation does, and work out a link budget and margin.

G8A01.why: Direct binary FSK feeds the digital signal **straight to the oscillator**, changing its frequency, with no audio tone in between.
G8A01.trap: Keying an FM rig with a tone is audio FSK, not direct.

G8A02.why: Changing the carrier's phase angle to carry information is **phase modulation**.

G8A03.why: Changing the instantaneous frequency of the wave is **frequency modulation**.
G8A03.trap: Frequency conversion is mixing, not modulation.

G8A04.why: A reactance modulator on an amplifier stage shifts the signal's phase: **phase modulation**.

G8A05.why: AM varies the carrier's height, so its instantaneous **power level** rises and falls with the voice.

G8A06.why: QPSK31 is sideband sensitive, has built-in error correction and is about as wide as BPSK31. **All three** are true.

G8A07.why: **SSB** drops the carrier and one sideband, so it is narrower than VSB, PM or FM.

G8A08.why: Overmodulation distorts the signal and creates extra sidebands: **excessive bandwidth**.
G8A08.trap: More drive never makes the signal narrower or fixes drift.

G8A09.why: FT8 sends data as one of **eight tones**: 8-tone frequency shift keying.

G8A10.why: Flat-topping is the distortion from **excessive drive or speech level**: the peaks hit the limit and flatten.
G8A10.trap: Proper ALC and carrier suppression are good things, not flat-topping.

G8A11.why: The envelope is the outline made by **connecting the peak values** of the modulated signal.
G8A11.trap: The carrier frequency and the bandwidth are different things.

G8A12.why: QPSK shifts the carrier by **0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees**, so each phase stands for a pair of bits.

G8A13.why: Budget = TX power + antenna gains − system losses, **as seen at the receiver**.
G8A13.trap: Gains minus losses leaves out transmit power. Power minus sensitivity skips gains and losses.

G8A14.why: Margin = received level − the **minimum level the receiver needs**. It is the room left for fades.
G8A14.trap: Transmit power minus sensitivity ignores gains and losses.
